sections.title: CHAIN OF COMMAND
sections.body:
Rank in ROC is a job, not a trophy. Every rank below is a lane somebody owns.

Command is appointed. Everything under it is earned by turning up, performing, and being trusted with other people. Promotions come from Command, one step at a time, and each one is filed on your record.

fields.name: 1iC  ·  First in Command
fields.value: Runs ROC. Owns the brand, recruiting, partnerships with other factions, the server and the bot. Final say on standards and on who gets removed.

fields.name: 2iC  ·  Second in Command
fields.value: Deputises for the First in Command and can run everything Command can.

fields.name: CMD  ·  Command
fields.value: The wider leadership group. Anything you would ask in public, Command can answer.

sections.title: 🥇  NON-COMMISSIONED OFFICERS
sections.body: *Earned. Trusted with other people. From Corporal 1 up you hold the NCO marker and its channel.*

fields.name: SSG  ·  Staff Sergeant
fields.value: Can run an op start to finish and deputises for Command.

fields.name: SGT  ·  Sergeant
fields.value: Leads a squad and runs training.

fields.name: CPL2  ·  Corporal 2
fields.value: Leads a fireteam and checks new joins out.

fields.name: CPL1  ·  Corporal 1
fields.value: Leads a fireteam.

fields.name: SPC2  ·  Specialist 2
fields.value: Briefs new joins and knows every loadout.

fields.name: SPC1  ·  Specialist 1
fields.value: Reliable, picks their own kit.

fields.name: PVT3  ·  Private 3
fields.value: A regular, trusted in a fireteam.

fields.name: PVT2  ·  Private 2
fields.value: Has ops on record.

fields.name: PVT1  ·  Private 1
fields.value: Verified, no ops yet. Everyone starts here.

sections.title: POSITIONS
sections.body: *Jobs, not ranks. Command appoints them and they stack on any rank.*

fields.name: Op Planner
fields.value: Writes the briefings and builds the scenarios, so ops are planned and not improvised at kickoff. More than one is fine.

fields.name: Liaison
fields.value: The one other factions talk to. Books joint ops, OPFOR and QRF requests, and answers fast.

fields.name: Media
fields.value: Records ops, runs <#1541926692983930950>, and keeps the advert fed with real footage.

fields.name: Something about an operation
fields.value: Whoever is running it, or an Op Planner, in <#1542215050108997684>.

fields.name: Your unit, or a specialisation
fields.value: Any NCO.

fields.name: Another faction wants us
fields.value: Liaison, or any Command member.

fields.name: Someone broke a rule
fields.value: Any Command member. Do not try to handle it yourself in <#1540826188094644438>.

fields.name: The bot is broken
fields.value: First in Command.
